criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Case and Death Statistics
categories.definition: User requests for specific numbers, counts, rates, or statistics regarding infections, deaths, testing, or recovery.

categories.name: Transmission and Surface Survival
categories.definition: User questions about how the virus spreads, including airborne transmission, surface longevity, and specific vectors like animals or objects.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: User inquiries regarding specific symptoms, identifying signs of infection, or interpreting personal health experiences.

categories.name: Prevention and Protective Measures
categories.definition: User requests for advice, tips, or guidelines on how to avoid infection, including the use of masks, gloves, and sanitation.

categories.name: Travel and Movement Restrictions
categories.definition: User questions about travel bans, domestic movement, safety of specific destinations, or essential travel definitions.

categories.name: Treatments and Cures
categories.definition: User inquiries regarding medical treatments, home remedies, vaccines, or the existence of a cure for the virus.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: User requests for the latest news, press releases, general updates, or current status of the pandemic.

categories.name: Donations and Financial Support
categories.definition: User intent to donate money, find donation links, or offer financial support to relief efforts and organizations.

categories.name: Sharing and Social Actions
categories.definition: User requests to share information, links, or the bot service with others via social media or direct messaging.

categories.name: Myths and Misconceptions
categories.definition: User questions or requests for information regarding specific myths, conspiracy theories, or misinformation about the virus.

categories.name: Virus Definition and General Information
categories.definition: User requests for a definition of the virus, general explanations, or broad educational information about COVID-19.

categories.name: High Risk Areas and Quarantine Guidelines
categories.definition: User questions about identifying high-risk locations or asking for guidelines and rules regarding quarantine and isolation.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: User utterances consisting of greetings, thanks, or other social pleasantries directed at the bot.
